Sugar Free Frosting
By: Carrie Barr
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:12pm

Ingredients




 ounces sugar free instant pudding mix, any flavor
1 3/4 cups milk
8 ounces cream cheese
8 ounces sugar free whipped topping, thawed

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl, combine pudding mix and milk. Mix well and let stand until thickened. 2 In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add pudding and mix well. Finally, fold in whipped topping.
